PSALM CXXI. 
 
  David assures himself of help from God, ver. 1, 2.   He assures others of it, ver. 3-8.   A song of degrees. 
 
  V. 1. Hills-To Sion and Moriah, which are called the holy mountains.
V. 5. Shade-To keep thee from the burning heat of the sun.
V. 6. Smite-With excessive heat.  Moon-With that cold and moisture which come into the air by it.  Intemperate heats and colds are the springs of many diseases.
